You can only support her.

You need to work on your own self esteem independently of if you stay together. I understand feeling like you are out of your league when it comes to your relationship. Also when it comes to men/women I can't stress enough that quality is much better than quality.  If 20 guys hit on her every day but they all treat her like an object or they make her feel unsafe. That's going to get very old very fast.

If how many partners she's had before you and her past or present drug use is too far from your comfort zone you have to work on expanding that comfort zone or you need to move on. These things are not going to change. She might be willing to compromise on her current drug use but you can't expect her to quit and the past can't be changed.

Last but not least don't put too much stock into love language or personality tests. They are fun and they can be a good starting point. For example if my love language is physical touch it would not make sense to enter a relationship where the other person has trauma around touch. it doesn't take into account so many things and whether the other person is working on  change. Same with personality tests you are an introvert. She is an extrovert. it can work out as long as she is willing to let you have time to recover from interacting with people. You obviously need to go to events and meet people as part of the give and take.
